name: io.github.tonyyang0504/trademe_jobs-mcp
description: Trade Me Jobs (jobs): me, search, get_posting. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_TRADEME_JOBS_CONSUMER_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Trade Me application consumer key (My Trade Me > My applications).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_TRADEME_JOBS_OAUTH_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Member access token from the OAuth 1.0a flow (Trade Me access tokens do not expire).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_TRADEME_JOBS_OAUTH_TOKEN_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Access token secret from the same flow.
